这个文件夹是 SpaceKnife 重复文件清理的恢复区。\n\n清理把一些副本:
This folder is the recovery area of a SpaceKnife duplicate-file cleanup.

The cleanup replaced some copies with links or block clones; the originals wait here, named “number-original name”; manifest.json says where each one was.

In SpaceKnife's “Duplicate-file cleanup history” you can undo the cleanup (the originals go back) or “Empty the recovery area” (the originals are checked, then deleted for good, freeing the space). You can also rename a file back to its old place by hand.

Please do not put other files here.
这个文件系统不支持原子交换，SpaceKnife 不替换这里的文件: This file system cannot swap names atomically: SpaceKnife replaces no files here
这个界面不支持重复文件清理方案: This interface does not support duplicate-file cleanup plans
这份内容从 {before} 份独立的变成 {after} 份（另 {links: This content goes from {before} independent copies to {after} (and {links} links)

这份是只读的：SpaceKnife 不改它的属性，就地克隆要写权限: This copy is read-only: SpaceKnife does not change its attributes, and cloning in place needs write access
这份是只读的：替换后这里的只读属性按新文件来: This copy is read-only: after replacing, read-only follows the new file

这对文件夹两边都留: This folder pair keeps both sides

这是版本库 {repo} 里的文件：会显示成删除，提交后别人那边也会删: This file is in the repository {repo}: it shows as deleted, and a commit deletes it for others too
这是版本库 {repo} 里的文件：就地改它会改到另一处；切换分支时会把它重写成: This file is in the repository {repo}: editing it in place edits the other place too; switching branches rewrites it as a separate file and the space comes back
